test('navigation clears target-specific dialogs and their unsent evidence',async({page})=>{await login(page);await route(page,'/records/customers/usr_customer_02');await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Add internal note'}).click();await page.getByLabel('Reason / evidence').fill('This note belongs only to the first reviewed customer');await route(page,'/records/customers/usr_customer_01');await expect(page.getByRole('dialog')).toHaveCount(0);await expect(page.getByText('This note belongs only to the first reviewed customer')).toHaveCount(0);await expect(page.getByRole('heading',{level:1,name:'Tunde Bello'})).toBeVisible();await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Add internal note'}).click();await expect(page.getByLabel('Reason / evidence')).toHaveValue('')});

it('review authentication snapshots cannot be mutated by a later MFA operation',async()=>{const a=new ReviewAPI();const session=await login(a,'enrol');const restored=await a.restore();expect(session.user.mfa_enabled).toBe(false);await a.request('POST','/v1/admin/auth/mfa/confirm',{code:'123456'});expect(session.user.mfa_enabled).toBe(false);expect(restored?.mfa_enabled).toBe(false);expect((await a.restore())?.mfa_enabled).toBe(true)});
it('review sessions do not leak mutable role references to clients',async()=>{const a=new ReviewAPI();const session=await login(a,'support');session.user.role='admin';const restored=await a.restore();restored!.role='admin';await expect(a.request('GET','/v1/admin/console/records/staff')).rejects.toMatchObject({status:403})});
